description:
## 0.2.0 (2026-10-03)

### ✨ New Features

* **Settings screen:** all options are in YouTube → Settings → Morphe → Thread Ripper (needs the official Morphe Patches). `debug.tr.*` system properties still override them for testing.
* **Stall recovery** (off by default): resume playback after a stall once 1.6 s of video is buffered instead of the app's 5 s.

### Changes

* **Video buffer preload:** default target raised from 300 s to 900 s (memory limit stays 250 MiB). The official "Playback buffer size" = Maximum buffers about 650 s at 1080p, so the old 300 s target buffered less than the official setting there. With both enabled you get the larger of the two.

Built for YouTube 21.16.256 with Morphe Patches 1.45.0 and Spoof video streams = visionOS. The settings screen was checked on an Android emulator; the effect of stall recovery on playback has not been measured yet.
